newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures lower on profit-taking.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures ended lower on Friday, extending losses later as profit-taking by private investors gained force ahead of the weekend, traders said.
The benchmark September contract was down 180 yen per tonne at 18,150 yen. The spot November closed down 330 yen at 18,880 yen. Volume was 53,401 lots.
"Despite the firmer Chicago market on Thursday, profit-taking increased ahead of the weekend," one trader said.
The spot September contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded weaker at $3.68 per bushel at 0918 GMT, against $3.70-1/2 at Thursday's close.
